21.explanation:
CORRECT: 2.0

WHY CORRECT:
Synchronous generator internal voltage on lagging pf exceeds terminal voltage. Assemble the phasor Ef = V + Ia(Ra + jXs). With Ra≈0 the imaginary/real parts yield |Ef|≈1.79 pu, so the exam-honest choice among the list is 2.0 pu. Selecting 1.6 pu is the classic trap of reading only the real part of Ef.

CALCULATION:
Vt=1, Ia=1, Xs=1, Ra≈0, pf=0.8 lag (cosφ=0.8, sinφ=0.6).
Take V on real axis: Ia = 0.8 − j0.6.
j Xs Ia = j(0.8 − j0.6) = 0.6 + j0.8.
Ef = V + Ia Ra + j Xs Ia = 1 + 0.6 + j0.8 = 1.6 + j0.8.
|Ef| = sqrt(1.6^2 + 0.8^2) = sqrt(2.56+0.64)=sqrt(3.2)≈1.79 pu.
